title: Minimal copy and hierarchy
guidance: Remove descriptions that merely repeat a title, badge or obvious action. Keep meaningful consequences, uncertainty, permissions and actionable validation. Prefer short lines or structured lists over paragraphs; use hierarchy and balanced wrapping instead of arbitrary line breaks.
Remove the verification explainer as explicitly requested. Long reviews may expand on demand; do not hide essential cancellation consequences or recovery guidance.
Bound long list headings at two lines; reveal complete names on job detail. Retain critical validation and irreversible consequences; do not ellipsize safety content.

decisions.title: Retain information that changes a decision
decisions.reason: Remove repeated status reminders, task intros and obvious sort explanations. Keep validation, permission, unknown result, missing prerequisites and irreversible consequences.

decisions.title: Compose the remaining copy
decisions.reason: Use one short statement or specific list. Balanced/pretty wrapping, intrinsic columns and enlarged-text fallbacks protect phrase flow; avoid arbitrary screenshot line breaks.

parameters.name: Shared text
parameters.description: Section/child hierarchy, consistent link color and wrap rules are inherited; source strings stay with the owning story.

status.human: feedback received; current revision awaits review
status.color: Purple rejected. Replacement slate-blue/blue-teal palette awaiting human judgment

exportNote: Decision-only extract. Rendered evidence and review history are excluded from this handoff. Human-unvisited states remain unvisited; no new visual acceptance is claimed.
